# BuildKit's parser and lexer test data

`parser/`, `parser-negative/` and `shell/` are moby/buildkit's
`frontend/dockerfile/parser/testfiles`, `testfiles-negative` and `shell`'s
`envVarTest` and `wordsTest` at dockerfile/1.27.1 (08f4630c67a49ff3158f218e99fd93ad97a90747), unmodified, under BuildKit's
Apache-2.0 licence in `LICENSE`. Regenerate with `scripts/dockerfile/generate`.
